objectives: Keep architectural ownership explicit and independently verified
constraints: Preserve independent repository boundaries; Platform does not own SDK or Deployment implementations
Use maintained platform contracts and owner public interfaces as engineering context
Use strict TypeScript classes and normal formatting; changed methods must satisfy the existing readability gate
No commits, branch changes, deployment, production publication or changes to historical composition pins
patterns: Document intent, observable acceptance, implementation, independent review
Use public package APIs and exact artifacts, never cross-checkout source imports
interfaces: Portable SDK contracts consumed by Platform and capability owners
purpose: Own portable SDK contract schemas and exported interfaces; consumers may request changes but cannot implement them in Platform
